text: BAM share fell 0.32 percentage points over 25 hours and 0.38 percentage points over 7 days, to 34.1%. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 22.2% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. Recent precursor signals span hkg, sqq, pit, ewr and ams, but the top-node change reads as whale-driven routing, not a validated structural rollover.
